title: REPLAY: Deal will mean 'Iran will never have a nuclear weapon', says Trump
summary: US ​President Donald Trump on Tuesday told reporters at the G7 meetings ​in France ‌that the ⁠memorandum of understanding with Iran ‌states clearly that Iran will not ⁠have a nuclear weapon. Trump said that he ​will release the text ‌of the U.S.-Iran memorandum in a formal setting.
